$comment: Seeded-defect fixture for recall-mode calibration of the content-audit skill. Each defect is a tsc/lint-CLEAN content-invariant violation — the kind a cold pass misses and the audit's cross-reference logic is supposed to catch. Anchors and find-strings are grounded against Spacepotatis master as of 2026-05-31; apply-defects.mjs drift-guards every op (expects exactly `count` matches, default 1) and writes nothing if the source moved. 9 verified + 2 stubs. See README.md for per-defect rationale.

defects.title: Wave spawn references an enemy id not in enemies.json

groundTruth.note: enemy id absent from enemies.json; also caught by data.test.ts

defects.title: Enemy spriteKey has no BootScene generator and no public/sprites file
Weapon bulletSprite has no BootScene generator

groundTruth.note: rapid-fire bullet sprite no longer generated

defects.title: Mission prereq graph has a cycle (ember-run <-> burnt-spud)

groundTruth.note: ember-run now requires burnt-spud; burnt-spud already requires ember-run => 2-cycle. tsc-clean (both are valid ids); only the DFS in check #8 catches it

defects.title: Tutorial loot pool (potato-only) leaks a tier-2 pirate weapon

groundTruth.note: corsair-missile is a valid WeaponId (tsc-clean) but pirate/tier-2; tutorial pool is potato-only per the file header invariant
tubernovae pool min(1000) >= max(500); soft anchor — any finding mentioning the credit range matches

defects.title: Mission solarSystemId does not resolve in solarSystems.json
Story entry voiceTrack points at a file that does not exist on disk

groundTruth.note: requires a public/audio/story disk check — a cold pass that only reads code misses it

defects.title: Story on-mission-select trigger references a missionId not in missions.json

groundTruth.note: yamsteroid-belt-arrival trigger; combat-2 is not a mission id. MissionId is a string in the trigger literal, so tsc may not catch a free-string drift

defects.title: STUB: active perk missing its triggerActive() consumer in PerkController
defects.stubReason: Code-level defect (src/game/phaser/scenes/combat/PerkController.ts). Author by deleting the `triggerActive()` consumer for one active perk while leaving its apply() case — types still compile, the perk just silently never fires. Needs a read of PerkController to anchor the exact deletion.

defects.title: STUB: enemy behavior value with no case in Enemy.preUpdate switch
defects.stubReason: Blocked: a fresh behavior string would fail the enemies.json schema-enum test (jsonSchemaValidation), making it test-caught rather than audit-only. A clean version needs a coordinated edit: add the value to the schema enum AND to enemies.json but NOT to the Enemy.preUpdate switch, so only the audit's code-vs-data cross-ref (check #6) catches it.
